## 👻 v1.1.0.3 — No more ghost streams, clearer settings & messages on native apps

**Recommended update for everyone.** Install it from **Dashboard → Plugins** (your server picks the right build), then restart Jellyfin.

| Jellyfin server | Version | File |
|---|---|---|
| 10.11.0 → 10.11.x | `1.1.0.3` | `StreamLimit-v1.1.0.3.zip` |
| 12.0 → 12.x | `1.1.1.3` | `StreamLimit-v1.1.0.3-jellyfin12.zip` |

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **This release fixes "ghost" streams.** Some users were shown with — and blocked by — streams they no longer had, sometimes while not even connected. If a user was wrongly blocked on 1.1.0.2, updating fixes it; no reset needed.

### 🐛 Fixes
- **Ghost streams are gone.** A stream now counts only while it is really active: Jellyfin reports it as playing, or media data is actually being sent. A connection left open without sending anything (phone asleep or offline, app killed, a transcode segment the client gave up on) stops counting after **90 seconds**, and is closed after 30 minutes. Finished or aborted requests never count.
- **A stop report or session end now always frees the slot**, even when old connections of that device are still open.
- **Playback negotiation is no longer stricter than the stream itself** — a stream that would have been allowed is no longer refused up front (e.g. after closing a browser tab).
- **Automatic cleanup every minute** of slots, stopped devices and internal registries, also for users who never come back.

### ✨ New
- **Your blocked message on native apps, by default** — Android TV, Swiftfin, Streamyfin, AFinity, Findroid… now receive your message as a 10-second notice instead of a silent spinner. When the Android app's native player is blocked, the message is shown by the app's own interface. Web clients keep the single popup — **no duplicates**.
- **Redesigned settings page** — six clear tabs (*Live, Limits, Blocking, Message, Notifications, Advanced*), a searchable user table showing the limit that really applies to each user, a live message preview and an always-visible save bar.
- **Clearer live view** — only what is counted, with the reason (*Playing, Streaming, Recently active, Stopped by the limiter*), idle time and open downloads.
- **Reset button per user** — frees everything a user holds in one click, as a last resort.

### 🔧 Under the hood
- Verified end to end on **Jellyfin 10.11.11** and **Jellyfin 12.3**, including a real browser, simulated Android TV / Android / web clients (exactly one message each, none on web), range requests and a connection that stops reading mid-stream.
- Admin stops now report live connections cut separately from stale entries cleaned up.

### 📦 Install
Add the repository in **Dashboard → Plugins → Repositories**, then install **StreamLimiter** from the catalog:
```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JellyboxAD/Jellyfin.Plugin.StreamLimit/main/manifest.json
```

> [!TIP]
> If the plugin shows *NotSupported* after updating: uninstall it, restart, reinstall it from the catalog and restart again. Your limits and settings are kept.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/JellyboxAD/Jellyfin.Plugin.StreamLimit/compare/v1.1.0.2...v1.1.0.3
